verdict: Native static implementation follows the declared directed-slot and capture contract. No confirmed native Rust interface mismatch found by source review. Compilation, end-to-end trace validation and execution are pending.

capture_mapping.native_object: Actual current authenticated session record decoded as complete State, re-encoded with its complete known fields; detached oracle owns that record and extracted initial directional chains.
capture_mapping.cut: before opportunity 1, after first opportunity network processing; budgets32/64
capture_mapping.future_private_access: Snapshot methods accept only captured record or later public wire. They contain no Pair, DeviceJournal, Fixture or signer reference.
capture_mapping.predictor: Separate HMAC-SHA256 HKDF extract/expand implementation matches production HKDF domain, index encoding, next-chain/message-key order and per-owner direction mapping.
capture_mapping.native_current_metric: For every derived candidate, the observer verifies equality with the actual next message key, decrypts the real native ciphertext with the candidate and matches its application payload, and verifies that the mutated captured seed fails AEAD authentication.

confirmed_mechanics: choose returns at most one frame and only its owner emits in the slot.
receive_control and receive_data create queued control/ACK outputs without emitting them.
Each class participates in a deterministic round-robin; blocked new requests remain in FIFO.
Data resume validates exact retained ciphertext; control output identity validates owner+target+tag exact bytes.
Network duplicate and protocol retry remain distinct transport events; duplicate consumed data cannot count as a new logical delivery.
Loss and reorder use opportunity coordinates matching schedule.py; terminal flush only delivers prior emissions.
Snapshot predictions are invoked only for new committed applications, so packet delivery reordering does not reverse the per-sender key stream.
Counting backend resets initial open sync count, bootstrap precedes measurement, and committed journal revision baseline is saved.
No raw keys, record payloads, private seeds or identity owners appear in native trace writes.

findings.finding: schedule.verify_trace now binds (owner,logical) to immutable frame bytes across slots; 12 tests pass including changed-retry and boolean-delivery-coordinate negatives.
decrypt_candidate uses the candidate key, exact real message header/ciphertext/tag and public AD. The candidate recovers the actual payload; altered-seed candidate must return Error::Authentication.

Native kind=retry identifies data retries only. Repeated control and ACK frames retain stable owner+logical identities but kind=control/ack. Total retransmission metrics should derive the repeated identity flag for all frame kinds.
next_message_id Suspended and RekeyRequired outcomes each emit admission_blocked with owner, request, opportunity and precise reason; request remains FIFO queued.
